page.layout: One page of text; a decorative woodcut border above the heading; no margin notes; a digitiser's watermark at the lower right is ignored.

main_text.head: Lectori S.
main_text.p: ANalium Evangelij renovati specimen hocce idcirco publico, Lector Christiane, ut quasi manu pulsem amicas doctorum virorum Bibliothecas, atq; inde eliciam historica ad continuandum hoc opusculum necessaria. Absq; his enim subsidiis sit, frustra quis in hoc studio desudet. Ad primam quidem Decadem non invitii symbolam suam contulerunt Nicolaus Henelius J. C. Caspar Cunradus Medicus Uratislaviensis, Caspar VVaserus Tigurinus, Joannes Cunradus Cochius

page.notes: The opening initial A is a large woodcut letter. Word "Cochius" is set on a line ending the paragraph, right-aligned. Some letters are doubtful due to print wear, notably "Ad" and "VVaserus". The decorative border is a printer's ornament, not text. The watermark "Digitized by Google" is excluded.
